frost_spirit_ring.name: Ring of the Frost Spirit
frost_spirit_ring.desc: Seals one essence’s skills, keeping its attributes. A Beastman can break it to awaken Skadia; all worn equipment is destroyed.
frost_spirit_ring.estimates: Compressed price1,500 versus novel market quote1,500,000; one consignment. Unknown essence attribute bonuses are not invented.

guardians_braces.name: Guardian’s Braces
guardians_braces.desc: Reduces incoming damage by5%. Activate to repel enemies and cleanse/protect nearby allies from harmful statuses. Dwarf protection lasts1.5× as long.
guardians_braces.estimates: Compressed price50,000 versus old novel market quote≈50million; one consignment. Charge conversion/reset, radius, round duration and cooldown are estimates. Status immunity does not prevent damage.

snowfield_club.name: Club of the Snowfield
snowfield_club.desc: A blunt Numbered weapon that adds frost damage to normal attacks.
snowfield_club.estimates: Price, weight, ordinary weapon statistics and added frost magnitude are estimates. The novel verifies the additional frost effect, not these coefficients.
